anchors.title: Agentic AI for Industrial Automation
anchors.company_evidence: Siemens has launched the 'Eigen Engineering Agent,' a purpose-built AI for industrial automation that autonomously plans, codes, configures, and validates engineering tasks end-to-end.
anchors.job_connection: The role requires building and optimizing agentic AI systems and conversational flows, specifically within the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem to handle complex business logic and automation.
anchors.candidate_evidence: The candidate has hands-on experience building and optimizing agentic AI systems, specifically working on a production multi-agent LangGraph pipeline at Astroraag.
anchors.anchor: The candidate's direct experience in designing and debugging multi-agent architectures aligns with Siemens' strategic push to deploy autonomous agents like the Eigen Engineering Agent, providing the foundational logic skills needed to build robust conversational agents in the Power Platform.

anchors.title: Production Reliability and Debugging
anchors.company_evidence: Siemens emphasizes moving AI beyond suggestions to executing tasks end-to-end, requiring high reliability in industrial settings where failures can have physical consequences.
anchors.job_connection: The job description explicitly demands a 'strong hands-on mindset' for building, testing, and improving solutions, as well as proactive troubleshooting and optimization of production systems.
anchors.candidate_evidence: The candidate traced a silent production failure in a LangGraph pipeline to a mismatch between graph.invoke() and graph.stream(), re-architecting the system to reduce debugging time by 60% and improve iteration speed by 40%.
anchors.anchor: The candidate's demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve complex, silent production failures in AI pipelines directly supports the job's requirement for proactive troubleshooting and ensuring the reliability of automated business processes.

anchors.title: Optimization of AI Operational Costs
anchors.company_evidence: Siemens is scaling Industrial AI across the value chain, including for 600,000+ TIA Portal users, which necessitates efficient and cost-effective AI deployment at scale.
anchors.job_connection: The role involves translating business requirements into technical solutions, which includes optimizing performance and resource usage for enterprise-grade AI applications.
anchors.candidate_evidence: The candidate optimized LLM pipelines by implementing prompt engineering, context engineering, and token budgeting, resulting in a 50% reduction in pipeline latency and a 70% reduction in operational cost.
anchors.anchor: The candidate's proven track record of significantly reducing latency and operational costs through technical optimization aligns with the need to deliver scalable, efficient AI solutions for Siemens' large-scale industrial user base.
